plan.en: A good plan helps us use time well.
plan.cn: 好的计划能帮我们用好时间。

time.en: Time goes fast when we are having fun.
time.cn: 玩得开心的时候时间过得真快。

clock.en: The clock on the wall ticks all day.
clock.cn: 墙上的钟一整天都在滴答响。

first.en: First, we read the story, then we answer the questions.
first.cn: 首先我们读故事，然后回答问题。

then.en: I had lunch, then I played.
First I do my homework, then I watch TV for a while.
then.cn: 我先做作业，然后看一会儿电视。

next.en: Next, we will sing a song together.
next.cn: 接下来，我们一起唱首歌。

finish.en: I finish my homework before dinner every day.
finish.cn: 我每天晚饭前完成作业。

homework.en: After I finish my homework, I can play games.
homework.cn: 我做完作业后就可以玩游戏。
